sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Centered text over full-width background, 100vh or min-h-[90vh]
elements: Headline: Create. Sing. Distribute.
Subheadline: The operating system for modern music creators.
CTAs: Start Creating (Primary), Distribute Music (Secondary)
Visuals: Use hero_waveform_bg behind text with an overlay of bg-black/40. Place rotating_music_orb image in a floating container below the text.

sections.name: AI Music Generator
elements: Text: Left aligned. Headline about Prompt-to-Song.
Visual: Mock UI card showing genre selection (Pop, Rap, Bollywood, etc.) and a glowing waveform.
Image: Use ai_studio_bg as a soft background or within the mock UI.

sections.name: AI Lyrics Generator
sections.layout: Grid cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-16 items-center flex-row-reverse
elements: Text: Right aligned.
Visual: Split-screen mock of a lyric editor. Use a typewriter effect simulation (or just staggered opacity) for verses.

sections.name: AI Studio (Vocal & Stem)
sections.layout: Stack layout. Large image below text.
elements: Text: Centered, emphasizing ElevenLabs-level sophistication for vocals and stem extraction.
Visual: Large bento-style container using stem_extraction_art image, with mock mixer sliders floating over it.

sections.name: Distribution
elements: Image: global_distribution_map in background.
Content: 'Release Everywhere', 100% royalties.
Logos: Row of streaming platform icons (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Amazon) rendered using react-icons or similar.

sections.name: Features Grid
sections.layout: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
elements: 12 Cards: AI Music Gen, AI Lyrics, AI Studio, AI Artwork, Stem Extractor, Mastering, Distribution, Artist Channel, Royalty Tracking, Analytics, Free UPC/ISRC, Instagram linking.
Style: Subtle glowing icons (use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react), minimal text, pure black cards with 1px border-white/5.

sections.name: Dashboard Preview
elements: Visual: Complex UI showing streaming analytics, earnings graphs (use Recharts with cyan/purple lines), royalty tracking.

sections.name: Pricing
elements: 3 Cards: Pro, Ultimate (Highlighted), Enterprise.
Highlight: Center card has cyan glowing border, 'Most Popular' glow badge.

sections.name: Testimonials
elements: Cards with avatar, quote, artist name, and a 'monthly streams' stat.
Avatars: Use provided Unsplash images.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.layout: Centered box, max-w-4xl, heavy padding, gradient background glow
elements: Headline: The Future of Music Starts Here.
CTAs: Start Free / Explore AI Studio

interactions.hover: All interactive elements must change state visually. Buttons lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase glow. Cards subtle border glow.
interactions.animations: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered staggered entrances (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1). Lightweight Canvas/CSS for audio-reactive particles.
interactions.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

libraries.icons: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react. For distribution logos, use react-icons (yarn add react-icons).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, react-icons, recharts.
Update tailwind.config.js to include Outfit and Manrope fonts. Include custom colors from the design guidelines.
All backgrounds must be pure black (#050505) with deep purple/electric blue accents. AVOID generic neon/cyberpunk clutter.
Follow 'Bento Grid' strict rules: use gap-6 or gap-8, pure black cards with 1px border-white/5.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on scroll. Keep motion elegant, not distracting.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Ensure the hero section uses the hero_waveform_bg with proper overlay to maintain text readability.
The external links for CTAs must be used as requested: https://release.sunodistro.com/ for plans/pricing, /auth/register, /auth/login.
